documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall. Revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores, reflecting a 60% year-on-year growth, while EBITDA reached INR18 crores with a margin of 14.9% and PAT stood at INR9 crores (7.5% margin). Management detailed plans to expand its retail footprint with new mega and mid-format stores in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar starting from Q2 and Q3 FY27. Furthermore, the company discussed its long-term strategic shift towards transitioning into an asset-light retail model, increasing the retail revenue mix to 75%, and progressively hedging its gold inventory through Gold Metal Loans. RBZ Jewellers Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial and operational results, highlighting an operational revenue of INR 1,208 Mn and an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix is targeted to become 50-50 in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term, with 75% being retail.
guidance.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that IIJS was very warm and encouraging, with good buyer growth and order backing, anticipating Q2 performance to be in line with earlier projections.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing. I think Quarter 2, we think that because of the orders and all, we are hoping that performance will be very much in line with whatever we have projected in earlier commentaries.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that revenue growth was driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that April has been very good in terms of business performance.
demand_outlook.quote: Now how has been April? April has been very good.

capex_expansion.claim: Surat store will be launched in Quarter 2 and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores have a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet with an inventory deployment of INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area. The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Small format stores have a carpet area of around 5,000 square feet with inventory deployment around INR50 crores plus/minus 10-15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex break-even for stores is expected to be achieved in a year or less.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 was INR121 crores, representing a 60% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR18 crores, up 39% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR9 crores, translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Retail revenue for Q1 stood at INR78 crores, registering a 70% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: In terms of segmental performance for the quarter, retail revenue stood at INR78 crores registering a robust 70% Y-o-Y growth.

margins_costs.claim: Wholesale revenue for Q1 stood at 42% (in context of growth percentage mentioned as 47% Y-o-Y growth).
margins_costs.quote: Wholesale revenue stood at 42% reflecting a strong 47% Y-o-Y growth.

margins_costs.claim: Average gold rate remained stagnant, resulting in negligible inventory gains in the system for Q1.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

margins_costs.claim: For the financial year 2026, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Total manufacturing capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory consumption or production is around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs, utilizing the factory at around 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During core season times like July, August, and September, capacity utilization generally goes to 75%-85% or sometimes near 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the season times, currently as of now, our capacity utilization generally goes at 70%, 80% minimum, 75%, 85% sometimes, depending on which days are all, sometimes it is near to 90% or so.
The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that by the end of this financial year, the debt-to-equity ratio will still be below 1:1, specifically around 0.8 debt to 1 equity.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to gear up the debt-to-equity ratio to 1.5 or 2:1 over a period of time, leveraging majorly through Gold Metal Loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Over the period of time we are wanting to gear up this to 1.5 or 2:1 debt equity ratio, wherein major leverage will be through Gold Metal Loan

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that it will take a week or two to understand how the market and consumers are reacting to recent events regarding customs duty and advanced authorization on gold imports.
risks_headwinds.quote: So see, these are very immediate events or it has just been a few days that these all things are happening. And generally, we would take some time, let's say, a week or 2, in fact, a little bit more to understand what -- how the market and the consumers are reacting.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the B2B to B2C revenue mix to reach 50-50 in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two

management_commitments.claim: Surat store is slated for launch in Quarter 2.
management_commitments.quote: Surat will be launching in Quarter 2

management_commitments.claim: Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to completely churn over the whole inventory to be hedged using GML in a three-year period.
management_commitments.quote: as and when the quarter passes we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
